metadata.description: Abid's portable Claude Code skills, grouped into installable plugins. Add the marketplace once, then install only the toolkits you want.

plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Engineering planning suite: plan-prep, task breakdown, sequential/supervised task execution, review guides, todos, and plan grilling.

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: Code cleanup and review: simplifier, inline review responder, systematic debugging, plus code-reviewer/architect/explorer agents.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: UI design workflow: discovery, ASCII/HTML wireframes, Storybook variants, iteration rounds, and component prop modeling.

plugins.name: qa
plugins.description: QA workflow: scripted and exploratory QA runs, manual QA case writing, and the qa-runner agent.

plugins.name: docs-knowledge
plugins.description: Documentation writers: SOPs, troubleshooting guides, conventions, product guides, architecture docs, and changelogs.

plugins.name: artifacts
plugins.description: Turn findings into polished, navigable self-contained HTML artifacts and keep markdown + HTML in sync.

plugins.name: meta-skilling
plugins.description: Meta tooling: create/improve skills, discover skills, agent architecture guidance, teaching, and conversation handoff.
